    def test_chef_suite_loop_timeline(logged_in_page):

        out = []
        t0 = time.monotonic()
    
        def stamp():
            return f"{time.monotonic() - t0:.2f}s"
    
        def on_response(r):
            path = urlparse(r.url).path
            if "curated" in path or "favorit" in path:
                out.append(f"{stamp()} RES {r.status} {r.request.method} {path}")
    
        page.on("request", lambda r: out.append(f"{stamp()} REQ {r.method} {urlparse(r.url).path}") if "curated" in r.url or "favorit" in r.url else None)
        page.on("response", on_response)
        for round_ in range(3):
            for index in range(5):
                out.append(f"{stamp()} === round {round_} card {index}: redirect")
                chef.redirect_to_chef_curated()
                out.append(f"{stamp()} redirect done")
                for step in range(2):
                    card = page.locator(ChefCuratedPage.RECIPE_CARD).nth(index)
                    heart = card.locator(ChefCuratedPage.GENERIC_HEART_ICON)
                    was_red = heart.get_attribute("color") == RED
                    heart.click()
                    toast = ChefCuratedPage.TOAST_REMOVED_FROM_FAVORITES if was_red else ChefCuratedPage.TOAST_ADDED_TO_FAVORITES

                            break
                        page.wait_for_timeout(200)
